title: Stromgarde Keep
wikitext:
Stromgarde Keep is the ruined capital city of Stromgarde, located on the southwest corner of the [[Arathi Highlands]] ([[Stromgarde location map|location map]]). It is divided into three sections - one under the rule of the [[Syndicate]], another largely under the control of the [[Boulderfist]] ogres (though the [[Witherbark]] trolls control small parts), while the last section remains under the control of the people of Stromgarde and serves as the headquarters of [[Prince Galen Trollbane]].

[[Lord Falconcrest]] commands Syndicate efforts in the Arathi Highlands from the ruined city. He is one of the most senior members of the organization. The Stromgarde militia based at [[Refuge Point]] has placed a bounty on his head, and have seeked the help of Alliance heroes. It is likely that his death would disrupt Syndicate efforts in the region to a great degree.
